description:
Intetics Inc., a leading American technology company specializing in custom software application development, distributed professional teams creation, software product quality assessment, and “all-things-digital” solutions, is looking for a Senior Full-Stack PHP Developer (Laravel + React/Vue) to join its innovative team.

Project Responsibilities

Build and maintain scalable, full-stack web applications using Laravel on the back end and React/Vue on the front end

Contribute to architecture decisions for applications built to scale: service design, data modeling, caching, and queue-based processing

Design and build RESTful APIs and integrations with internal and third-party systems

Develop reusable Laravel packages and front-end components shared across projects

Own quality and performance: refactor legacy code, optimize queries, and improve response times

Write automated tests and take part in code reviews and CI/CD improvements

Document technical decisions, APIs, and specifications

Work with product, design, QA, and engineering teams to scope and deliver features

Ensure software development best practices and timely delivery of product functionality

Candidate's Portrait

We're looking for a full-stack developer who owns features end to end, from database design and APIs to the React/Vue interface users actually interact with. You'll build and scale business-critical web applications, working closely with product, design, and QA teams to transform requirements into reliable, maintainable, and high-performing software. We value engineers who understand the bigger picture, question unclear requirements early, and care about long-term maintainability as much as delivery.

Must-haves

5+ years of professional experience with modern OOP PHP (8.x)

3+ years of hands-on experience with Laravel

Strong knowledge of the Laravel ecosystem: Eloquent, Queues, Jobs, Events, Service Container, Middleware, Authentication

3+ years of production experience with React or Vue

Strong TypeScript and modern JavaScript skills

Experience designing RESTful APIs, including authentication, validation, and error handling

Solid SQL skills (MySQL or PostgreSQL)

Experience with schema design, indexing, and query optimization

Hands-on experience with Redis and queue-based architectures

Experience with automated testing (PHPUnit, Pest, Jest, Vitest, or Playwright)

Comfortable with Git-based workflows, pull requests, and CI/CD pipelines

Experience working in AI-assisted development environments (Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, etc.)

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

Good written and spoken English

Nice-to-have

Inertia.js, Livewire, or Next.js/Nuxt

Tailwind CSS

Docker and cloud infrastructure (AWS, Forge, Vapor)

Static analysis tools (PHPStan, Larastan)

Code quality and formatting tools (Pint)

Real-time features (WebSockets, Reverb)

RabbitMQ or other message brokers

Microservices architecture experience

Experience with event platforms

Experience with ticketing systems

Experience with payment integrations (Stripe, PayPal)
